# ADR 0007: Demo seed generated by a fixed client id

Date: 2026-10-03. Status: accepted.

## Context
Two fresh tabs that each seed demo text would duplicate it after syncing.

## Decision
Build the seed in a throwaway `Y.Doc` with `clientID = 1` using `prosemirrorJSONToYXmlFragment`, encode it, and apply that update in every session before the editor mounts. Identical struct ids mean the second application is a no-op, even after the user deleted the seed text. Verified on 2026-10-03: two independently built seeds encode to identical bytes and merge to one copy.

## Consequences
- No "is the doc empty?" race.
- What we gave up: client id 1 is reserved for the seed; real peers get random 32-bit ids, so a clash is negligible.
